por_que: Tanda 4, de prueba (sin tocar la skill): los paquetes de los tres vídeos de prueba (1311, prueba-3, ramon) rehechos con el molde de los viajes de la tanda 3, donde manda la IA: solo su cara como referencia (y el animal real cuando sale), escenario espectacular inventado, luz de cine (hora dorada, neón, tormenta), ropa según la escena y el animal o el atrezo pegado a su cara. Mismos títulos que los paquetes.
prefijo: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard and build (same person, do not beautify, do not change his age). Ignore the background and clothes of the attached photo; dress him as described.
sufijo: FRAMING: close shot, his face about 30 % of the frame height, well lit, looking straight into the lens, calm wide-eyed deadpan, mouth closed. His body is cut by the frame edge or by something meaningful in front, never by the ground. STYLE: like a top YouTube thumbnail: one huge hero prop or animal that tells the story, right next to his face; a spectacular, cinematic setting with dramatic light, like a travel postcard; bright saturated colors, clean uncluttered background, everything razor sharp. Photorealistic, like a real photo, not an illustration, no plastic AI skin. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, nothing in the bottom-right corner.

conceptos.titulo: Me Di 1 Hora para Decorar un Estanque Entero
conceptos.idea: Jardín japonés a la hora dorada (puente rojo, farol, arce, niebla); él metido en el estanque con vadeadores abrazando un montón de plantas; despertador rojo gigante medio sumergido sonando junto a su cara
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a dreamy Japanese garden pond at golden hour: a red arched wooden bridge, a stone lantern, a red Japanese maple, soft mist over the water, orange koi under the surface. He stands waist-deep in the pond in olive fishing waders over a white t-shirt, hugging a huge dripping armful of water plants and lotus. Right next to his face, a giant vintage red alarm clock, as tall as his torso, stands half-submerged in the water, ringing hard: the bells vibrating, ripples spreading around it.

conceptos.titulo: Intenté Salvar Plantas de una Tierra de Cemento
conceptos.idea: Atardecer sobre tierra agrietada como cemento; una planta verde con las raíces atrapadas en un bloque de hormigón; él de rodillas con un martillo neumático que levanta polvo dorado
conceptos.escena: SCENE: sunset over a vast cracked ground baked as hard as concrete, glowing orange sky. In the foreground, one lush green reed plant whose roots are locked inside a solid grey block of concrete. He kneels right behind it in a dusty work shirt, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, gripping a yellow jackhammer that blasts up a cloud of dust and concrete chips glowing in the backlight.

conceptos.titulo: Mi Perro Gigante No Me Deja Plantar el Estanque
conceptos.idea: Ragnar de pie dentro del estanque, la cabeza mojada junto a su cara, con un nenúfar arrancado en la boca; gotas al sol; él con la maceta vacía
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white fluffy dog. SCENE: a sunlit garden pond full of water lilies, sparkling backlight. The dog stands in the pond right beside him, its big wet head next to his face, proudly holding an uprooted water lily with long dangling roots in its mouth, water splashing and droplets sparkling in the sun. He stands knee-deep in the water in a rolled-up shirt, holding an empty plant pot.

conceptos.titulo: Un Pájaro Salvaje Estrenó Mi Estanque Nuevo
conceptos.idea: Hora dorada; el pajarito, enorme en primer plano, chapoteando en el estanque recién hecho con la cinta roja cortada; él detrás con las tijeras doradas
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the bird: keep the exact same tiny species and plumage (yellow crown stripe with black edges, white wing bars). SCENE: golden morning light over a brand-new pond with lotus flowers and a red satin ribbon just cut across it, its ends floating. In the near foreground the bird bathes on the pond edge, wings spread, splashing a crown of droplets lit by the sun, very close to the lens so it looks as big as his head. He leans in right behind it in a smart white shirt, holding giant golden ceremonial scissors.

conceptos.idea: Atardecer en un jardín tropical; lleva en brazos un trozo entero de estanque como una tarta (agua clara, nenúfares, juncos y un koi naranja dentro)
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a lush tropical garden at sunset, warm rim light. He carries in both arms, close to his chest, a whole cube-shaped chunk of pond like a giant cake: a slab of dark earth topped with clear water held in place as if by magic, water lilies, reeds and one bright orange koi visible inside, water spilling over his forearms. He wears a straw hat and a linen shirt.

conceptos.titulo: Las Luces «Estancas» de Mi Selva se Han Llenado de Agua
conceptos.idea: Selva de interior con lluvia y rayos de luz; sostiene un fluorescente estanco convertido en acuario, con medakas dentro y agua cayendo a chorro, que le ilumina la cara
conceptos.escena: SCENE: inside a misty indoor rainforest enclosure: rain falling, giant leaves, bromeliads, god rays through the fog. He holds up toward the camera, right under his face, a long waterproof fluorescent tube light that is completely flooded like an aquarium: water sloshing inside, small silver medaka fish swimming inside the tube, water pouring out of both ends, the tube still glowing cyan and lighting his face from below. He wears a soaked dark t-shirt.

conceptos.titulo: Las Luces de Mi Selva No Aguantan la Lluvia
conceptos.idea: Selva de interior bajo un aguacero; él empapado sujeta un paraguas sobre el fluorescente del techo, no sobre sí mismo, y saltan chispas donde cae el agua
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a dark indoor jungle under a torrential tropical downpour, cold blue light and mist. He stands soaked to the bone, hair dripping, in a wet t-shirt, holding a big yellow umbrella up, not over himself but over a glowing fluorescent ceiling light just above his head; where raindrops hit the edge of the light, bright sparks fizz.

conceptos.titulo: Mi Selva se Ha Quedado sin Luz
conceptos.idea: Selva enorme de noche, niebla azul de luna; solo su linterna, cuyo haz cae sobre Safira a su lado; fluorescentes muertos colgando arriba
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his caiman lizard (Dracaena guianensis): keep exactly the same species, the olive-green body with bumpy scales and the bright orange head (not a crocodile, iguana or monitor). SCENE: a vast rainforest enclosure in total darkness, blue moonlit fog, a few fireflies; dead fluorescent tubes hang broken from the ceiling above. His flashlight is the only light: its warm beam falls on the caiman lizard lying on a rock right beside his face, its orange head glowing, eyes reflecting the light. He wears a headlamp switched off and a dark jacket.

conceptos.titulo: Unos Peces Samuráis Me Están Ganando la Guerra
conceptos.idea: Poza de la selva al atardecer; tres medakas saltan hacia él como samuráis, con cinta roja en la frente y una katana diminuta; él se defiende con el salabre
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a jungle pool at sunset, warm backlight, splashes frozen in the light. Three small silver medaka fish leap out of the water toward him like samurai warriors, each wearing a tiny red headband, the leading one holding a tiny katana. He crouches at the pool edge in a wet shirt, raising a small fishing net like a shield, the fish right next to his face.

conceptos.titulo: Mi Lagarto Caimán No Me Deja Arreglar las Luces
conceptos.idea: Selva de interior con rayos de luz; él subido a la escalera cambiando un fluorescente y Safira tumbada sobre sus hombros agarrando el tubo, la cabeza junto a su cara
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his caiman lizard (Dracaena guianensis): keep exactly the same species, the olive-green body with bumpy scales and the bright orange head (not a crocodile, iguana or monitor). SCENE: a lush indoor rainforest with misty god rays. He stands at the top of an aluminium step ladder changing a fluorescent tube, in a grey t-shirt with a tool belt. The caiman lizard lies draped across his shoulders, its orange head right beside his face, its claws gripping the end of the fluorescent tube he holds and pulling it away.

conceptos.titulo: The "Easy" Russian Tortoise That Keeps Dying
conceptos.idea: Una nube de tormenta diminuta lloviendo dentro del terrario sobre la tortuga rusa; él limpia el cristal empañado con la cara pegada
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a cozy room at dusk, warm lamp light. On the table in the foreground, a glass terrarium with a Russian tortoise (Testudo horsfieldii: flat rounded olive-brown shell with dark blotches) inside, and a tiny grey storm cloud floating inside the tank raining hard on the tortoise, the glass fogged and streaming with water, puddles on the sand. He leans in right beside the tank in a cozy sweater, wiping a clear patch on the fogged glass with his hand, worried.

conceptos.titulo: Africa's Most Endangered Tortoise Fits in One Hand
conceptos.idea: Cámara acorazada a oscuras con un foco y láseres rojos de seguridad; la tortuga egipcia en un cojín de terciopelo bajo una campana de cristal en su palma enguantada
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a dark museum vault, one dramatic spotlight from above, thin red security laser beams crossing the background. He holds out toward the lens, in a white-gloved palm, a tiny Egyptian tortoise (Testudo kleinmanni: very small, pale ivory-yellow shell with dark edges) sitting on a red velvet cushion under a glass cloche, like a priceless jewel. He wears a black suit.

conceptos.titulo: There's an Amazon Rainforest Behind This Door
conceptos.idea: Pasillo de piso corriente; abre una puerta blanca y revienta una Amazonía con cascada, niebla, guacamayos y lianas que entran al pasillo; el lagarto caimán en el umbral
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is a caiman lizard (Dracaena guianensis): keep exactly the same species, olive-green body and bright orange head. SCENE: a plain beige apartment hallway. He holds open an ordinary white door; through it bursts a gigantic Amazon rainforest with a waterfall, mist, golden god rays, scarlet macaws flying, vines and leaves spilling into the hallway. The caiman lizard stands on the doorstep right next to his legs. He wears a hoodie and slippers, looking at the lens.

conceptos.titulo: Baby Snake-Necked Turtles Eat Like Piranhas
conceptos.idea: Orilla de un río de selva al atardecer; una docena de crías de cuello de serpiente salen del agua como pirañas, cuellos estirados, hacia el grillo de sus pinzas
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a jungle river bank at sunset, golden backlight. He crouches at the water's edge in a khaki explorer shirt, holding up a cricket with long tweezers just above the surface, right next to his face. A dozen baby snake-necked turtles (tiny flat brown shells, extremely long thin necks) erupt from the water like a piranha frenzy, necks stretched, mouths open, water exploding in sparkling droplets.

conceptos.idea: Tormenta con rayos; jardín inundado de agua marrón; la sulcata flota en una barca hinchable a su lado y él la empuja con chubasquero amarillo
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a dramatic storm, dark clouds and a lightning bolt, a garden flooded with brown water, a small tortoise house half-submerged behind. Right beside him floats a small inflatable rubber dinghy carrying a big sulcata tortoise (Centrochelys sulcata: huge tan shell with growth rings), calm and dry. He wades waist-deep in a yellow raincoat, pushing the dinghy, rain pouring.
